biography.plain_text: Chang Yung-fa was the Taiwanese founder of Evergreen Group. A former sea captain, he established Evergreen Marine with one used cargo ship and built an international container-shipping network. He subsequently expanded into aviation through EVA Air, alongside land transport and hotels, retaining personal stakes in the businesses he had created.

long_biography.plain_text:
Shipping founder Chang Yung-fa collected maritime objects long before opening a museum. Gifts from shipyards and business associates joined purchases from international auction houses, including ship models, marine paintings and navigational instruments. He wanted to organise the collection and share it with the public. The Evergreen Maritime Museum opened in Taipei in 2008, giving students and other visitors a place to explore the history and technology of seafaring.

His foundation also established the Evergreen Orchestra with twenty musicians. It expanded into a full symphony orchestra, providing training and employment for musical talent in Taiwan. Its programme brought classical music to a broad public while also performing Taiwanese folk music.
